individuals.treatment_summary: Previous/surgical: NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), colchicine, mesalazine, CS (corticosteroid), MTX (methotrexate), CyA (cyclosporin A), TCZ (tocilizumab), ADA (adalimumab), ETN (etanercept), IFX (infliximab), TOF (tofacitinib), CAN (canakinumab), GLM (golimumab), HCT (hematopoietic cell transplantation). Current: none listed. Refractory; underwent HCT because of resistance to various immunosuppressive therapies and has remained in remission without anti-inflammatory therapy for 5 years post HCT; MTD blood trough level high. Anti-drug antibodies: anti-ADA positive at secondary failure, negative after discontinuation of ADA; anti-IFX negative at secondary failure; anti-ETN negative at reduced ETN efficacy; anti-TCZ negative after discontinuation.
